headline: Trump Administration Modifies Canadian Import Tariffs Ahead of Midterms
summary: The Trump administration rolled back tariffs on Canadian agricultural equipment while imposing duties on other goods, with the changes set to take effect on October 30.
why: Trade tariffs between the US and Canada directly impact supply chain costs, agricultural machinery margins, and North American cross-border commerce.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Lifting duties on Canadian agricultural equipment reduces capital costs for US farming operations.
